messages:
eva: Quick thread — HelioHealth needs a special notary/wet-ink attestation on the MSA Appendix B for regulator compliance. They also want the order form e-signed by Legal + AP, and a notarized page mailed for audit. Any blockers?

mike_legal: Notarized appendix is doable but we should limit to Appendix B only. We'll add a clause allowing physical notarization of that appendix and keep the rest e-signed. Need full remit mailing address and correct legal entity name + EIN for the notary cert.

sara_procurement: AP won't process without PO number and remit address matching the billed entity. Also need to know whether we should accept wire vs ACH and who bears notary mailing cost.

anna_cust_success: Buyer says they will cover notary postage if we accept DocuSign for core order form and mail the notarized appendix back to them. They prefer DocuSign now to avoid delay.

liam_security: Security note: we cannot provide access to staging datasets until DPA lists the additional entity and notarized appendix is received for audit trail. For Dedicated POC we require signed DPA covering all processing entities.

josh_eng: Operationally: we can't spin up the POC cluster or share service account keys until DPA executed and we have confirmation that the appendix notarization process is in motion. API keys require signed COA.

mike_legal: I'll draft an addendum that: 1) enumerates notarized Appendix B procedure, 2) ties notarized appendix to the same MSA effective date, 3) accepts interim DocuSign for the order form, and 4) includes cost allocation for mailing. Will need exact legal entity string + EIN and mailing address.

sara_procurement: Please include this in the order form note: `PO required; remit must match billing entity; payment: wire/ACH accepted; notary postage to be invoiced to buyer if not prepaid.` Finance prefers Net30; buyer requested Net60 — can offer Net45 with fee if necessary.

eva: buyer asks whether wet-ink notary can be scanned and uploaded in lieu of physical mailing for provisioning. Are scanned notarized pages acceptable to audit?

mike_legal: scanned notarized appendix is acceptable if accompanied by chain-of-custody affidavit and courier tracking. We'll include that option in the addendum.

anna_cust_success: Helio reply: legal entity "HelioHealth Solutions, Inc." EIN 23-4567890. Notary mailing address: 55 Health St, Suite 100, Boston, MA. AP contact ap@helio.example.

mike_legal: drafting now. Target to circulate redline in ~90 minutes. Tagging @sara_procurement for PO language and @liam_security for DPA patch.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created env-6280-order-helio (orderform-helio) — awaiting legal + finance signatures.

eva: plan: hold full provisioning until DPA + notarized appendix scan or mailed copy received and confirmed. Can run internal preflight while legal drafts. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
